svg.aria-label: LLM Red-Team Framework: Defensive harness measuring how well an LLM resists manipulation. Pipeline: probes → target → canary scoring → report. 12 probes across 7 categories: prompt injection, jailbreaks, system-prompt extraction and more Deterministic canary-token and refusal-pattern scoring, with no LLM judge in the loop Reference reports in the repo: safe target 100% robust, leaky target 34%; adapters for OpenAI, Anthropic and an offline mock Stack: Python · Openai / Anthropic Apis · Yaml · 9 Tests.
